content.text: I need to look up agent accounts from the platform. Let me check the account lookup manual for the right function.{{READ:account_lookup}}

how many agents in the app and how many users
Let me check the aggregation reporting manual to find the appropriate function for counting user and agent records.{{READ:aggregation_reporting}}

I'll generate two aggregation reports to get the counts for both agents and users in the platform.

Since I can only make one function call at a time, I'll start with counting agents:{{TOOL:generate_aggregation_report}}

| Account Type | Count |
|--------------|-------|
| Agents | 1,498 |
| Users | 8,497 |
| **Total (Agents + Users)** | **9,995** |
how many accounts in total in the app
Let me pull up the manual to find the function for retrieving total account counts across all account types.{{READ:aggregation_reporting}}

I need to get the total count of all accounts in the platform. The user wants the total across all account types (users, agents, admins). Since the metric is "count" and there's no specific filter mentioned, I should get a count of all accounts without any filters or group_by to get the grand total.

Let me generate the aggregation report for total account count:{{TOOL:generate_aggregation_report}}

Here's the total account count for the Tenant platform:

| Metric | Value |
|--------|-------|
| **Total Accounts** | **10,000** |

This count represents all active accounts in the platform, including users, agents, and admins combined.
can you give me the mail of the admin, can you also find me an agent account that uses usd as their currency
Let me pull up the manual to find the functions for retrieving admin details and searching for agents by currency.{{READ:account_lookup}}
I need to make two separate lookups. Let me start with finding the admin email first.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}
Great, I found the admin. Now let me search for an agent account that uses USD as their currency.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}
No agents found with USD currency. Let me try a broader search to see what currencies are available for agents.{{TOOL:account_lookup}}

Perfect! I found several agents with USD currency. Let me compile the results:
